post.topic: Automated Emergency Intake and Job Dispatch for Home Services
post.headline: Stop Losing Nighttime Emergency Calls to Competitors
post.subline: How home service businesses can capture, qualify, and dispatch urgent repair jobs 24/7 with custom AI.
post.caption:
A pipe bursts at 11 PM. The customer calls three local plumbers. The first one to respond gets the high-ticket job.

If your business phone goes to voicemail after hours, you are leaking high-margin emergency revenue every single week.

Here is a simple AI workflow concept:
1. An AI assistant answers calls or texts instantly 24/7.
2. It qualifies the emergency, logs job details, and captures pictures via SMS.
3. Urgent jobs immediately alert your on-call technician with exact dispatch info.

Practical tip: Set up a missed-call text-back rule that instantly texts caller a quick emergency intake link whenever a call drops after 6 PM.

post.insight_note: Home service providers lose their highest-margin emergency jobs outside business hours, making 24/7 automated intake an easy-to-understand, high-ROI workflow concept.
